record.passage: School punishment is a hierarchy of penalties used to punish infractions of rules in a school setting. Giving punishment to a child or an adult for doing something wrong often serves a good purpose. Such punishment makes the offender realize that the person has done something wrong. It serves as a deterrent and a warning that he should not commit a wrong and get away with it. In case, the person is not punished for committing wrong, he might repeat the sin or mistake, and as such the wrong doers will never learn. Corporal punishment involves: Parental Corporal Punishment that is, within the family in which children get punished by parents or guardians and the School Corporal Punishment that is, within the schools, when students are punished by teachers or school administrators. School corporal punishment covers official punishments of school students for misbehaviour that involve striking the student a given number of times in a generally methodical ceremony. The punishment is usually administered on the hands with an implement specially kept for the purpose such as a wooden paddle, or leather strap. The corporal punishment is prompted and everyone is afraid of it. Punishment should be according to the crime. It may prove counterproductive if it is excessive or inadequate. Harsh treatment never pays and is generally indefensible. By awarding punishment, many offenders can be reformed and rehabilitated. People with bad habits can be made to give up their muddy modes of life with patience and perseverance. Teachers and the students are burdened with heavy syllabus so teachers are forced to be strict to complete syllabus and so they feel the best and the easiest way to gain control over students is through punishments.
